event.description: Share corresponding LayerNorm affines across recurrent depth
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family, both accepted: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0029, which shared QKV and both feed-forward matrices at 2,144 parameters and 99.14%; there is no failed in-family result. Attempt-0032 most recently showed shared feed-forward width 15 peaking at 98.75% internal validation, so width 16 is restored. Hypothesis: because both depth steps already reuse attention and feed-forward transforms, corresponding pre-attention and pre-FF LayerNorm affine parameters can also be shared while the residual state changes between applications; this yields a fully recurrent block with 2,064 unique parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested partial tie of LayerNorm weights alone because it directly tests whether any depth-specific normalization affine state is required and realizes the complete 64-parameter saving.
